name: Download vocabulary content through the API

description: POST /vocabularies/{vocabularyName}/versions assigns the next version number, stores the new
version as ACTIVE and deprecates every older ACTIVE version in the same transaction (D4, D7).

elements.name: A new version gets the next number, becomes ACTIVE and deprecates the previous one

steps.name: a new version request for vocabulary "A"
the request field "changelog" is "Added concept two."
the response field "href" equals the response header "Location"
the response field "changelog" is "Added concept two."
the response field "creationDate" is a UTC timestamp to the second
the response has no validation warnings

elements.name: Every older version is DEPRECATED after several new versions

steps.name: a new version request for vocabulary "A"
versions 1, 2 and 3 of vocabulary "A" have status "DEPRECATED"

elements.name: Older versions deprecated by a new version take its creation time as last update date

steps.name: the clock has moved on by more than one second
a new version request for vocabulary "A"
I remember the response field "creationDate" as "v2created"
I send a GET request to "/vocabularies/${A}/versions/1"
the response field "lastUpdateDate" equals the remembered "v2created"
